---
title: "US Senate"
---

```{r}
source("R/setup.R")

senate <- headline_results()
senate_by_county <- headline_by_county()
margins <- county_margins(senate_by_county, counties)
```

```{r}
tagList(
  test_data_banner(),
  status_bar(counties),
  waiting_message(senate)
)
```

```{r}
if (is_test_data()) {
  p(class = "test-contest-note", "Showing the 2024 presidential race, since 2024 had no US Senate race.")
}
candidate_bars(senate)
precincts_line(senate)
```

## Margin by county

```{r}
county_map(margins, senate_by_county)
```

```{r}
counted <- sum(!is.na(margins$margin))
p(
  class = "map-note",
  paste0(
    "Counties with votes counted: ", counted, " of 100. ",
    "White counties have not reported yet. ",
    "Hover over a county to see its results. ",
    "Margin is the Democratic share minus the Republican share of all votes cast in the county."
  )
)
```
